headline: Hawai'i Hilo's unbeaten run ends at UCCS
dek: Hawai'i Hilo went to UCCS with three wins and no defeat, and came home with their first loss and only the third goal they have conceded. No other programme has won as often, and none in the conference is now without a defeat.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's ten goals have come from nine different scorers, yet they have conceded eight and lost as many matches as they have won.

wire.line: No side in the conference is unbeaten any longer; Hawai'i Hilo's first defeat came at UCCS after three wins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one draw and four defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost all four of their matches, scoring three and conceding ten; the trip to Saint Martin's was the fourth defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Pacific's nine goals have come from seven different scorers, yet they have conceded ten and won only one of their four matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Robert Ronco has scored both of Vanguard's two goals, from fourteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican (Calif.) have drawn three of their five matches and won none, scoring eight and conceding ten.

last_match.line: Chaminade have yet to take a point from any match; Saint Martin's had already won at Westmont.

next_match.line: Cal State Monterey Bay have already beaten Dominican (Calif.), Jessup and Vanguard; Point Loma have lost only away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
